info.name: SaaS Catalog API
info.description:
Multi-tenant SaaS catalog backend (NestJS + Fastify + Drizzle + PostgreSQL).

See docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md in the repo for full endpoint documentation.

Setup:
1. Import the accompanying "SaaS Catalog API - Local" environment and select it.
2. Set adminEmail/adminPassword (and superadminEmail/superadminPassword) to a seeded user.
3. Run Auth > Login (Tenant Admin) and/or Auth > Login (Superadmin) — tokens are saved automatically.
4. For Store (Public) requests, set storeHost to a hostname registered in the domains table.
5. Create-flow requests (categories, products, etc.) auto-save their created id to the environment for use by nested/related requests.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login, refresh, and logout. No bearer token required — these routes issue credentials.

request.description: Rate-limited to 5 req/min. On success, saves accessToken/refreshToken to the environment for use by every other CMS request.

Same endpoint as tenant admin login — role comes from the DB record. Saves tokens under superadminAccessToken/superadminRefreshToken so the Platform folder can use them independently of the tenant admin session.
Rotates the refresh token — the old one is revoked on use.
Revokes the refresh token. Returns 204 even if already invalid.

item.name: Store (Public)
item.description: Public storefront — tenant resolved via the X-Tenant-Host header (falls back to X-Forwarded-Host, then Host). Set the 'storeHost' environment variable to a hostname registered in the domains table for your tenant.

item.name: CMS (Tenant Admin)
item.description: Authenticated tenant-admin routes. Uses the {{accessToken}} obtained from Auth > Login (Tenant Admin). Superadmin accounts (no tenantId) get 403 on all of these except Profile.

item.name: Profile
item.description: Own user profile — works for any authenticated user.

request.description: slug is optional — auto-generated from name (slugified, de-duplicated) if omitted.

item.name: Products
item.description: Product catalog CRUD + lifecycle (draft -> published -> archived) + nested sub-resources.

request.description: Created as status "draft". slug is optional (auto-generated if omitted).

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Kaos Polos Premium",
  "slug": "kaos-polos-premium",
  "description": "Kaos katun combed 30s, tersedia berbagai ukuran.",
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "basePrice": "85000"
}

request.description: Only allowed while status = draft (409 otherwise — archive instead).
multipart/form-data, single file field, max 5MB, image/jpeg | image/png | image/webp only. Select a file in the Body tab before sending.

item.name: Product Marketplace Links
item.description: External marketplace listings for a product (e.g. Tokopedia, Shopee).

item.name: Domains
item.description: Custom hostnames the tenant's storefront resolves on.

item.name: Activity Logs
item.description: Audit trail of mutating CMS actions for the tenant.

item.name: Platform (Superadmin)
item.description: Requires a superadmin JWT — uses {{superadminAccessToken}} obtained from Auth > Login (Superadmin). Regular tenant admins get 403.

request.description: Also creates an empty store_settings row for the new tenant.

item.name: Admin Users
item.description: Cross-tenant admin-user management (role=admin only; superadmins are hidden).
